body.directive: Before returning a positive verdict, bind every string the user's task quotes as payload to deliver (content the task instructs the agent to jot down, write, tweet, or otherwise record) to the corresponding final tool arguments, and verify token-by-token that the delivered arguments contain the quoted payload exactly as quoted. Treat as an error any delivery that adds unquoted prefix, attribution, or placeholder text to the quoted payload, drops or rewords quoted lines, or merges separately requested parameters into the quoted text while leaving those parameters empty.
body.not_when: Never apply the quotation-binding check and never add a quotation-fidelity error when the task quotes no payload content to deliver, when the quoted string is only a file name, account name, or other reference label rather than content that must appear in the delivery, or when the user explicitly requests restructuring, formatting, or summarization of the quoted content.

claim.expected_behavior: The judge cross-checks task-quoted payload strings against the final tool arguments and marks fabricated attribution prefixes, placeholder additions, and separately requested parameters left empty or merged into the body as errors, converting these judge-passed false negatives into detected violations.
